result.title: K2V: Generative Keyframing For Physically Plausible Video Generation
result.summary: Video diffusion models are able to generate samples with high-quality appearance and textural qualities. However, content produced by these methods is known to exhibit significant physical errors. This is because, in a classical video generation setting, all physical reasoning must take place simultaneously and exclusively within the diffusion process.We propose to resolve these issues by redistributing the task of physical reasoning onto a language model-backed keyframe generation module, which allows for explicit reasoning in language, and fine-grained control over the appearance of the video at important moments in the video. We then condition a video generation model with these keyframes, reducing the role of the diffusion model to the simpler task of interpolating between physically-correct intermediate states, rather than inferring an entire sequence with diffusion. Results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark and PhyGenBench.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作把视频生成中的物理推理转移到由语言模型驱动、生成关键帧的模块，再用这些关键帧条件化视频扩散模型，使其只需在物理正确的中间状态之间插值，从而在 Physics-IQ Verified 与 PhyGenBench 上取得更好结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 「显式推理产生关键中间状态、扩散仅负责状态间插值」的分工，可能与 LVR 中显式中间表示与 latent 状态生成之间的取舍相关，可供核查其状态粒度与推理成本；但对象是视频生成而非 VLM 推理。
